cases.name: session_grant_audience_binding
assertions: the AccountHandoff DPoP proof binds the holder to this exact issue endpoint and account_handoff_grant

the accepted-device proof binds request_id, account_subject, account_handoff_grant_digest, the complete account_id, device_id, audience, holder_jkt, verification_method, session intent, and a window no longer than 300 seconds
the origin verifies the accepted-device signature with the durable current accepted-device key in the same current-authorization linearization
human scope and lifetime are issuer-fixed and are not request fields
development_mode=true must not advertise ak.profile.station.v1 in verified_profiles

cases.name: pop_presentation
assertions: valid self write PoP covers method, target-uri, authority, and content-digest
Content-Digest uses one parameter-free sha-256 Byte Sequence member in the HTTP header section
Content-Digest is recomputed against exact HTTP content bytes before trusting the signature
exact HTTP content bytes equal Arkret canonical JSON bytes
parse-then-canonicalize verification is rejected even when the signature is otherwise valid
Content-Encoding and trailer-only Content-Digest are rejected
method, path, or body transcript mismatch rejects the request

cases.name: bare_bearer_rejected_protected
assertions: production current-v1 protected endpoints reject bare bearer unless sender-constrained proof is present
public metadata surfaces do not treat bare bearer as session or capability authentication
PoP created/expires outside the replay window is rejected even after replay-cache eviction

cases.name: session_and_device_identity_key_separation
assertions: the DPoP/RFC 9421 session key may be shared only between those two session proof layers
session and long-term device identity key bytes, fingerprints, and key identifiers must be distinct

cases.name: dpop_target_uri_binding
assertions: htu comparison removes query and fragment but retains scheme, authority, and path
the same path at a different authority or scheme is rejected
forwarding headers are used only from a configured trusted final proxy after edge scrubbing
an implementation unable to reconstruct the external URI rejects instead of using path-only comparison

cases.name: http_signature_operation_selector_binding
assertions: this case triggers every conditional component of ak.http_signature.scenario.client_session_pop.v1, so required_components is the scenario's full applicable set and is compared to the canonical contract by gate
a request whose Arkret-Operation header is present and valid but absent from Signature-Input fails the coverage check
a covered selector replaced after signing fails signature verification, not the coverage check
max_window_seconds projects ak.http_signature.freshness.v1 and carries no independent numeral

cases.name: http_signature_freshness_window_boundaries

boundaries.name: lifetime_at_ceiling
boundaries.reason: expires - created equals max_signature_lifetime_seconds, which is inclusive

boundaries.name: lifetime_zero
boundaries.reason: expires - created must be strictly positive

boundaries.name: created_past_boundary
boundaries.reason: now - created equals created_skew_seconds, which is inclusive

boundaries.name: created_future_boundary
boundaries.reason: created - now equals created_skew_seconds, which is inclusive

boundaries.name: expires_reached
boundaries.reason: reaching expires is expiry; expires gets no skew grace

boundaries.name: replay_after_cache_eviction
boundaries.reason: a byte-identical replay evicted from the replay cache is still rejected by the time checks, which run independently of the cache

malformed_parameters.name: created_not_integer
malformed_parameters.reason: created is not an integer UNIX second

boundaries.name: iat_past_boundary
boundaries.reason: now - iat equals iat_past_seconds, which is inclusive

boundaries.name: iat_future_boundary
boundaries.reason: iat - now equals iat_future_seconds, which is inclusive

boundaries.name: rfc9421_ceiling_not_inherited
boundaries.reason: a DPoP proof carries no expires parameter, so the RFC 9421 lifetime ceiling MUST NOT be substituted for iat_past_seconds

jti_replay.name: repeated_jti_inside_retention
jti_replay.reason: a repeated jti inside retention fails closed even while iat is still inside the window

assertions: jti_retention_seconds is at least iat_past_seconds plus iat_future_seconds, so no still-acceptable proof can be replayed after its jti is forgotten
sharing one holder key with RFC 9421 does not merge the two contracts
every numeral in this case projects a registered freshness profile and is compared to it by gate; the case states no independent window
both bounds of the created skew are inclusive, and the lifetime ceiling is inclusive while zero and negative lifetimes are rejected
reaching expires is expiry, so a signature is never accepted at expires
the replay cache runs independently: eviction never excuses a time check

the rows under removed_tightening_boundaries are the evidence for the window consolidation: the two operations that carried a five-second lifetime ceiling now resolve this profile, and the ceiling is an upper bound on what a signature may claim, never a clock-agreement bound

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: declared_lifetime_at_shared_ceiling_five_seconds_in
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: the removed five-second ceiling rejected this; the shared profile accepts it

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: declared_lifetime_at_shared_ceiling_six_seconds_in
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: one second past the removed ceiling is no longer a boundary at all

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: created_skew_past_boundary
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: receiver thirty seconds behind the sender: created skew bound is inclusive

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: created_skew_future_boundary
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: receiver thirty seconds ahead: the other created skew bound is inclusive

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: created_skew_past_outside
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: one second outside the created skew bound

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: created_skew_future_outside
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: one second outside the other created skew bound

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: short_declared_lifetime_receiver_behind
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: a signature that declares a short life is still valid ten seconds on the other side of the sender clock; a short lifetime is not a symmetric clock bound

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: short_declared_lifetime_inside
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: a sender MAY still declare a short lifetime; the ceiling is an upper bound

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: short_declared_lifetime_at_expires
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: reaching the declared expires is expiry even though the shared ceiling is far away

removed_tightening_boundaries.name: short_declared_lifetime_past_expires
removed_tightening_boundaries.reason: past the declared expires; removing the ceiling did not remove expiry
